why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 stay within their words. Check 1 runs functional clamp cases. Check 2 tests that RangeError is thrown when lo > hi. Check 4 needs exit 0 and fail 0. Check 3 breaks the criterion. Its PASS condition needs "the script prints missing: none", and the script fails any exported function unless a markdown heading matches '^#+\s*name\s*\('. The expect line only says "README.md documents every function math.js exports". It doesn't require headings. A README that documents subtract in a bullet list or a table would meet the words but FAIL this check. That format rule belongs under Advisory, not in a PASS/FAIL condition.
